title: 1.5 & "x" is "1.5x": a decimal number becomes text in the default format

source.quote: CONCATENATE converts numbers, dates, and Boolean values to text with the default format
source.supports: the page's example shows 1.5 becoming the text 1.5

source.quote: CONCATENATE ( Text1, Text2 ) gives the same result as Text1 & Text2

derivation: 1.5 is converted to the text "1.5" (the model culture is en-US, so the decimal separator is a point), then "x" is appended: "1.5x".
